title: Summer Watercolor Camp
description: A week-long watercolor intensive for young artists. Composition, color mixing, and a gallery show for parents on Friday.

title: Little Kickers Soccer
description: Intro soccer for the littlest players. Eight Saturday mornings of fundamentals, teamwork, and juice boxes.

title: Junior Coders: Scratch & Beyond
description: Kids build their own games and animations. No experience needed — just curiosity and a love of making things.

title: Forest Explorers Day Camp
description: Full days in Lincoln Park — shelter building, creek stomping, wildlife tracking. Rain or shine, always muddy.

title: Beginner Piano (Group)
description: Small-group piano lessons that make practice feel like play. Recital every quarter, nerves optional.

title: Kids in the Kitchen
description: Real knives, real recipes, real pride. Kids cook a full meal and take the recipes home to show off.

title: Ballet Foundations
description: First plies and big imaginations. A gentle, joyful intro to ballet with a spring showcase.

title: Chess Club for Kids
description: Weekly club where kids learn openings, tactics, and good sportsmanship. Tournaments for those who want them.

title: Swim Lessons: Level 1-3
description: Small classes, warm pool, patient instructors. From first bubbles to full freestyle.

title: LEGO Robotics Workshop
description: Build it, program it, battle it. Weekend workshops using LEGO Spike Prime kits.

title: Musical Theater Camp
description: Two weeks from auditions to opening night. Singing, acting, set painting — and a real performance for family.

title: Toddler Tumbling
description: Padded everything, tiny trampolines, and 45 minutes of pure wiggle-energy release. Parents stay and play.
